name: Honda Forza (NSS300 / NSS350)
engine: 279 or 330 cc liquid-cooled single, fuel injected, CVT
intro: Honda's midsize maxi-scooter. Early 2014-2015 bikes had fuel pump and brake line recalls, so check those first.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2014-2015 NSS300 Forzas had two fuel pump recalls (14V672 and 16V661), some 2014 bikes a rear brake line recall (16V109), and 2014-2015 bikes a starter relay recall (15V439).
A-002.reason: A seized fuel pump stalls the engine while riding. All fixes are free.

recalls.what: A resin bracket inside the fuel pump can swell and jam the impeller, so the engine can stall.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the fuel pump free.

recalls.what: Fuel pump can seize and stop fuel flow, so the engine stalls.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the fuel pump free.

recalls.what: Rear brake line joint may not be torqued right and can leak fluid.
recalls.fix: Dealer checks and fixes the joint free.

recalls.what: Starter relay switch can fail, so the bike may not start, or the starter may keep running.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the starter relay free.
